mapper.sql: id, tenant_id, product_id, product_name, order_id, order_no, order_item_id, user_id, reviewer_name, reviewer_avatar, rating, content, status, hidden_reason, hidden_by, hidden_by_name, hidden_time, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM dms_shop_product_review WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND status = 1 ORDER BY create_time DESC, id DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) AS review_count, COALESCE(AVG(rating), 0) AS average_rating FROM dms_shop_product_review WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND status = 1

SELECT oi.id, oi.order_id, oi.order_no, oi.product_id, oi.sku_id, oi.product_name, oi.sku_name, oi.sku_attrs, oi.product_cover, oi.price, oi.quantity, oi.total_amount, oi.pv_value, oi.total_pv, oi.cost_amount, oi.total_cost, oi.create_time FROM dms_shop_order_item oi INNER JOIN dms_shop_order o ON o.id = oi.order_id LEFT JOIN dms_shop_product_review r ON r.order_item_id = oi.id WHERE o.user_id = #{userId} AND o.status = 3 AND o.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND oi.product_id = #{productId} AND r.id IS NULL ORDER BY o.receive_time DESC, oi.id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dms_shop_product_review (tenant_id, product_id, product_name, order_id, order_no, order_item_id, user_id, reviewer_name, reviewer_avatar, rating, content, status) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{productId}, #{productName}, #{orderId}, #{orderNo}, #{orderItemId}, #{userId}, #{reviewerName}, #{reviewerAvatar}, #{rating}, #{content}, #{status})
